name: Mace of Smiting
description: An iron mace with a head shaped like a clenched fist.
body:
## What it does

It strikes truer and harder than a plain mace, and truer and harder still against a construct. On a 20 it smashes for more, and a construct left with 25 hit points or fewer by that blow is destroyed.

damage.note: against a construct, with 2 more to hit
on a 20, or 4d6 against a construct
